singing_board.description: Interactive singing surface — touch points map to pitch and timbre, creating a spatial instrument where position becomes sound.
singing_board.name: Singing Board
singing_board.qfep_connection: Ode to Joy stored as semitone offsets, beat durations, and vowel targets in the F1/delta plane, with vibrato as a 5.5 Hz wobble on the ratio. Song compressed to coordinates plus a formant field — and the irreducible part is that the residue still sounds like someone singing.

vowel_instrument.description: Vowel space as musical instrument — navigate the formant plane to produce vowel sounds. Front/back, open/close become coordinates in phonemic space.
vowel_instrument.name: Vowel Instrument
vowel_instrument.qfep_connection: The mouth is relocated to the hand: lowering it opens a jaw you do not have, pushing it forward advances a tongue, trigger pressure is breath. Formant space (F1/F2) becomes reachable space — speech re-staged as gesture, its hidden musculature made public and grabbable.

vowel_sound_board.description: vowel(formant1, formant2) -> pulse_train filtered through formant resonances
vowel_sound_board.name: vowel_sound_board

dna.fixture_note: The board starts a phrase at t = 1.0 s and the shutter opens at 1.1 s, so without this the mapper's point and the word label are caught 0.1 s into 'Right Here Right Now' - different frames of an animation on top of the axis being measured. Ambient off leaves the board at rest so the tiles differ only by what `chart` draws. Bench only; the shipped default is true and every placement keeps speaking.
dna.default: chart=anchors - `none` is the only value that skips the shipped label loop; every other value runs it unchanged and then adds to it, so `anchors` reaches the end of _spawn_visual_anchors() and stops, node for node the build the 4 placements have always had. No mesh, no material and no extra child is created at the default. apply_grid_config is gated three ways - the key must be present, the word must be in CHARTS, and the value must have CHANGED - and only rebuilds after _ready has drawn once, so a config call naming nothing this board owns cannot tear the chart off a live placement.
dna.was: three exports, all of them audible or temporal: phrase_selection (12 words), is_ambient_enabled, repeat_interval. apply_grid_config existed but only accepted `say` and `repeat`, i.e. more speech. The board's whole visual argument - that a vowel is a POSITION in an F1/F2 plane, which is what its @identity truth says - was one hard-coded loop hanging seven billboarded phoneme labels at their coordinates. The plane itself was never drawn.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-05, refused by the runner as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. The formant plane IS a real diagram and the board did draw its landmarks - the seven ANCHORS labels - but not the space: no figures, no bounding figure, no continuum. The four alternatives are four positions in phonetics, not four decorations: a vowel as a named landmark (anchors), as an unlocated sound (none), as a measurement in Hz (ticks), as a vertex of the canonical published quadrilateral (quadrilateral), or as one conventional stop on a continuum that has none (field). REFUSED, and this is the tempting one: an axis over ANCHORS or the F1/DELTA bounds - a child's vowel space, a soprano's, another language's - which is a live argument about whose mouth is the reference, but retunes the instrument instead of changing it, and would render as the same seven labels a few pixels apart. ALSO REFUSED: everything audible. phrase_selection's twelve words, repeat_interval, pulse_hz, the plosive/fricative/nasal chain. The evidence is one still PNG and this board's real work is a time series of formant transitions; twelve phrases photograph as twelve identical boards.

vowel_synth.description: Real-time vowel synthesis from formant parameters — adjust F1 and F2 frequencies to morph between vowel sounds. Hear the geometry of the vowel triangle.
vowel_synth.name: Vowel Synthesizer
vowel_synth.qfep_connection: A voice from almost nothing: one pulse train, two resonant filters, and consonants as scheduled interruptions — closure, burst, decay stamped onto a sample clock. The throat exposed as a filter bank, which reads as reduction or liberation depending on who gets to own the voice.
